post.title: The IRS will never call demanding a gift card
post.ig:
The IRS will never call demanding a gift card.

Fake IRS callers took over $114 million from 16,281 people, March 2013 to March 2025 (TIGTA). That's about $7,000 each.
Government impersonators took about $920 million in 2025 (FTC).
The real IRS mails a letter first and never demands gift cards, wires or immediate payment.

Sources: TIGTA, FTC (2026), IRS.gov.
News and education, not financial advice.
